motion.name: motion-gate
motion.purpose: Set inline before paint only when prefers-reduced-motion is not reduce; removed if the self-hosted Motion library failed to load. All scroll motion requires it.

motion.name: scroll-scene
motion.value: Motion scroll(animate(...)), ease linear, target .scene, offset [start start, end end], section 240vh
motion.purpose: Photo scale 1 to 1.14, brightness 0.95 to 0.3; copy fades out 6%-28%; cut-out truck from translateY(-24vh) scale(0.24) (phones -17vh, 0.3) through scale(0.72) at 40%, scale(1) at 66%, to translateY(75vh) scale(2.7) at 100%, graded from night (brightness 0.62, saturate 0.75, hue -8deg, blur 1.5px) to daylight with 3px motion blur at the end; claim fades in 36%-50%.

motion.name: word-reveal
motion.purpose: Statement words switch from word-unlit to mist in reading order.

motion.name: fleet-settle
motion.value: scale(1.18) to scale(1), offset [start end, end end]
motion.purpose: Fleet photo settles into its 28px frame on entry.

motion.name: shuttle
motion.value: 5.5s cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1) infinite, holds 8% at each end
motion.purpose: Shuttle dot A to B; paused unless 40% visible (IntersectionObserver).

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Scene is a 100svh static stage with the truck parked lower right and no claim; all statement words lit; no fleet zoom; shuttle dot still; pill transitions and press scale off.

breakpoints.name: lg

photography.sources: Only real photographs supplied by SPN-Transporte (owner upload, 2026-10-19). No stock, illustration or AI imagery.
photography.provenance: Every shipped raster in assets/img has a sidecar <file>.webp.json recording origin and edits.
photography.privacy: Driver name tags in windshields are blurred before publishing.
photography.cutout: actros-frei: a single Actros with background removed (rembg isnet-general-use), name tags blurred, bottom edge faded; used only as the scroll-scene truck.
photography.format: WebP with two srcset widths each; scene photo preloaded, others lazy.
photography.framing: Edge to edge only in the scroll scene; elsewhere clipped to the 28px card radius or masked into a black card.

narrative.overview:
The site is staged like a product launch, and the product is SPN's own fleet of silver Mercedes-Benz Actros. Every section is a full-width stage, either pure black or a cool mist grey, and the two alternate down the page so each new topic arrives as a change of light. Headlines are large, tight Geist set in two lines: a statement in full ink and a quieter second line in muted grey. Real photographs of SPN's trucks, at night and by day, carry the proof. Nothing is illustrated and nothing is stock.

The page is sparse and confident: one idea per stage, generous section padding, few elements, big type. Colour is almost absent. Brand red (#d0111f) is the single signal and only marks things the visitor can do or things SPN promises (the check marks). The company's own wordmark, red wide italic Saira with a black outline as it is lettered on the trailers, is the only logo.

Motion is used once, big, and then quietly. The opening scene is a sticky scroll stage in which a cut-out SPN Actros leaves the night photo of the fleet row and drives past the camera. Everything after that is supportive: a statement whose words light up as you read, a fleet photo that settles into frame, a red dot shuttling between A and B. With reduced motion the page is a calm static document with nothing lost.
keyCharacteristics: Full-bleed black and mist stages alternating: scene, statement (black), Leistungen (mist), Fuhrpark (black), Über uns (mist), Kontakt (black), footer (mist).
Two-line Geist headlines: ink first line, muted second line, weight 650, tracking -0.035em.
28px rounded cards and fully rounded pills; no square buttons, no hairline-boxed cards.
Red is a verb: actions, the shuttle dot, check marks, list markers. Never decoration.
Only real SPN photographs, each with a provenance sidecar, driver name tags blurred.
One signature scroll scene; supporting motion stays small and stops when off screen.

rules.name: The Red Is a Verb Rule
rules.body: Signal red marks only what the visitor can do (pills, the phone hover) or what SPN promises (check marks, the shuttle dot, list markers), plus the wordmark. It never fills a section, a headline, a card or a decorative shape.

rules.name: The Two Stages Rule
rules.body: Every section takes the full width on either True Black or Mist, and neighbours alternate. No third ground colour, no gradients between stages; white and graphite exist only as cards and panels sitting on a stage.

rules.name: The Muted Second Line Rule
rules.body: Muted greys are always the partner of an ink colour on the same ground: muted-on-mist with graphite, muted-on-black with mist. They are never swapped across grounds.

rules.name: The Two-Line Headline Rule
rules.body: Section and scene headlines are a full-stop statement followed by a muted second line in the same size and weight. The hierarchy comes from colour, not from a second size.

rules.name: The Wordmark Only Rule
rules.body: Saira appears only as the SPN-Transporte wordmark: red fill, black outline via text-stroke (0.06em, painted under the fill). On black grounds the outline is dropped because it would vanish anyway. Saira is never used for headings or labels.

rules.name: The Flat Cards Rule
rules.body: Cards and panels never cast shadows; they separate from the stage by tone alone.

dos: **Do** alternate full-bleed True Black and Mist stages, each with the same section padding (clamp(5rem, 14vh, 9rem)).
**Do** write headlines as a statement plus a muted second line at the same size, Geist 650 with -0.035em tracking.
**Do** keep every button a pill (999px) and every card or framed photo at 28px (1.75rem).
**Do** use only real SPN photographs. Ship each raster with a provenance sidecar (`<file>.webp.json`) stating origin and edits, and blur any driver name tags before publishing.
**Do** self-host every font, script and image; the page makes no third-party requests.
**Do** gate every motion behind the `has-motion` class, set only when prefers-reduced-motion is not reduce and the Motion library loaded, and make the static state complete on its own.
**Do** pause looping motion when it leaves the viewport.
**Do** keep the phone number reachable in one tap: the red Anrufen pill in the nav on every page and viewport.
donts: **Don't** use Signal Red for surfaces, headlines, decorative shapes or large areas; it marks actions and promises only.
**Don't** add drop shadows to cards or buttons, or border cards with hairlines.
**Don't** use stock, illustrated or AI-generated imagery, invented fleet figures, customer logos or reviews.
**Don't** set headings, labels or body text in Saira; it is the wordmark only.
**Don't** introduce a third stage colour or gradients between stages.
**Don't** add a second scroll-driven set piece; the truck scene is the one signature, everything else stays supportive.
